string.text: Every 5 seconds: true if Invictus is still possible, false if it has become impossible (story off, Ironman off, ironman death flag, Veteran/Survivalist no longer both 3, those diffs were changed, or debug). Does not check whether you already have the achievement or have finished Afterglow. If it goes true to false, shows Clamitas at the top of the screen for 30 seconds.
Poll whether Invictus is still possible and show Clamitas if it becomes impossible.
